name: Intercom
whatYouLose: AI agent trained on your help center with handoff to humans
Shared inbox with assignment, SLAs and reporting for a support team
prompt:
Build a live chat widget and support inbox, an Intercom alternative for a small SaaS.

Stack: Node + Hono, SQLite, WebSockets, a vanilla JS embeddable widget (<15KB).
Features:
- Widget: launcher bubble, conversation view, offline email capture, unread badge, identity via signed user hash.
- Agent inbox: conversations list, assign, close/reopen, canned replies, internal notes, typing indicators.
- Email fallback: if the visitor leaves, replies are emailed and email replies are threaded back in.
- AI draft: suggest an answer from docs in /kb (markdown) using an LLM API; the agent approves before sending.
Done when: a visitor message appears live in the inbox and the agent's reply appears in the widget.
notes: Chat and inbox are buildable. The AI agent, mobile SDKs and team reporting are the part priced per seat.
